title: Hazel and the Gravity
author: W. M. Voss
blurb: Ines Villalobos, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
